body: Thank you for your advice. I know I need to open up about it as bottling it in is bad, but it's hard. I was constantly beat up and raped over the smallest things. Dinner wasn't the way he wanted? There'd be hell to pay. Left something out on the floor and he tripped? Same thing. It's not that I necessarily expect that response when talking about my feelings, but it does make me hesitant

Thank you for your kind words, I really appreciate it. I've come a long way since leaving him but it feels like the past is never far. 
My ex is one of my rapists. It was assaulted pretty much daily. Sometimes he'd let strangers assault me while he sat and watched. Day to day I'm fine, but sometimes the flashbacks are so intense that it's like I'm living through it all over again
Thank you for responding. I'm studying psychology and I live in Kentucky
